description: Simple SOC-voltage model: V = OCV(SOC) - I*R_internal

cell.name: Generic solid-state Li cell (LiCoO2 / sulfide solid electrolyte / Li metal)
cell.source: Janek & Zeier (2016), Nat. Energy 1, 16141; QuantumScape & Solid Power patents

internal_resistance.note: Approximate DC resistance at 25C, 50% SOC; SSE typically higher than liquid Li-ion

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) polynomial fit: OCV = a0 + a1*SOC + a2*SOC^2 + a3*SOC^3 + a4*SOC^4 + a5*SOC^5
ocv_coefficients.source: Polynomial fit to representative solid-state Li cell discharge curve (similar to NMC with higher upper cut-off)

temperature.note: F1a ignores temperature effects; SSE often operated warmer
